title: Euclid's Lemma in Bézout Domains and PIDs

problemStatement.formal: \forall R \text{ (CommRing)}, \text{IsCoprime}(a, b) \land a \mid bc \Rightarrow a \mid c
problemStatement.plain: Can euclids_lemma_int be generalized to arbitrary Bézout domains or PIDs? YES: it holds in any CommRing via IsCoprime, with IsRelPrime ↔ IsCoprime in IsBezout rings.
whyMatters: Unifies Euclid's lemma across ℤ, ℚ[X], ℤ[i], and all Euclidean domains with a single proof
Shows that IsCoprime is the universal Bézout condition — ring axioms alone suffice
Connects IsRelPrime (arithmetic) and IsCoprime (algebraic) via the IsBezout typeclass

proven: euclids_lemma_ring: holds in ANY CommRing via IsCoprime (linear_combination proof)
isBezout_coprime_iff: IsCoprime ↔ IsRelPrime in IsBezout rings
euclids_lemma_irreducible: irreducible p, p|ab → p|a or p|b in DecompositionMonoids
knownResults.goal: Formalize Euclid's lemma at the maximum level of generality in Lean 4

currentState.nextAction: Gallery entry created and PR submitted

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Proved euclids_lemma_ring in ANY CommRing. Key finding: IsCoprime is already the abstract Bézout condition, so the proof needs no IsBezout — just ring axioms and linear_combination. Added IsBezout connection via IsRelPrime.isCoprime + IsBezout.span_pair_isPrincipal, and DecompositionMonoid version for irreducible=prime. Instances: ℤ, Polynomial ℚ, GaussianInt.
builtItems: isBezout_relPrime_to_isCoprime: IsRelPrime → IsCoprime in IsBezout rings (BezoutIdentityOQ02OQ02.lean:96)
isCoprime_to_relPrime: IsCoprime → IsRelPrime in ANY CommRing (BezoutIdentityOQ02OQ02.lean:109)
insights: IsCoprime a b = ∃ u v, u*a + v*b = 1 IS the abstract Bézout condition — works in ANY CommRing
linear_combination v * hk - c * huv closes Euclid's lemma by pure ring arithmetic
IsBezout.span_pair_isPrincipal provides Submodule.IsPrincipal instance needed for IsRelPrime.isCoprime
IsRelPrime.isCoprime requires [Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})] as instance — use haveI
IsBezout.isCoprime_of_dvd does NOT exist in Mathlib v4.26.0; use IsRelPrime.isCoprime instead
GCDMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime does NOT exist; use irreducible_iff_prime with DecompositionMonoid
Polynomial ring over field needs noncomputable for EuclideanDomain/IsBezout instances
mathlibGaps: IsBezout.isCoprime_of_dvd not available in Mathlib v4.26.0
nextSteps: Consider: constructive divisibility algorithm combining BezoutIdentityOQ01.extGcd with euclids_lemma_ring
Consider: Gauss's lemma (ℤ[X] version) — does linear_combination scale?
